# #4470: Patch: follow-up to #4458 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4458 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4458 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44993024179)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`59c8529162a1`). `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4458 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts:65`: The change never lowers `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES`, and its new comment says it did: the constant was already 458_752 (56 × 8192) on the base, set by #4435, and the 447,192-byte measurement was taken on a tree without #4435's savings, so the budget now sits about 9% over the real first load instead of about 2%.
  Evidence: `git show 26a963264f:apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts | grep 'BUDGET_BYTES ='` prints `70:export const FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES = 458_752;`, and the diff leaves that line alone. The #4435 paragraph already on the base says it measured 445,874 bytes (27,664 less than #4222's 473,538) and set 56 × 8192. The #4428 paragraph says 447,192 bytes, 26,346 less than that same 473,538 baseline. Two measurements, each counted from #4222 and each smaller, can only come from two trees that each lack the other change. With both changes merged, the first load should be about 473,538 − 27,664 − 26,346 ≈ 419,500 bytes. The issue's criterion is "`FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is lowered by the measured saving, and its comment records the before and after". Fix: on current `main`, run `pnpm --dir apps/web build:e2e`, measure the entry chunk plus its preloads the same way the test does, set the budget to the smallest multiple of 8192 about 2% over that figure, and rewrite the #4428 paragraph with the real before (445,874, #4435's) and after. Put the paragraph after #4435's, since #4428 merged second.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
